summary: Created MoviesListView.axaml and MoviesListView.axaml.cs. The AXAML declares x:DataType=\"vm:MoviesListViewModel\" on the root UserControl plus a separate xmlns:coreOpts alias for VideoIndexer.Core.Options. A two-column Grid hosts (column 0) a toolbar with a ShowCoverPanel CheckBox (OneWay + ToggleCoverPanelCommand), a DataGrid (SelectionMode=Extended, AutoGenerateColumns=False, CanUserSortColumns=True) with all 12 columns where each DataGridTextColumn/DataGridCheckBoxColumn carries x:DataType=\"models:MovieListItem\", header context menus whose CommandParameter uses {x:Static coreOpts:MoviesListOptions+ColumnKeys.*}, a ProgressBar (IsVisible=IsLoading), and an empty-state TextBlock (IsVisible=IsEmpty). Column 1 holds a cover-panel Border unconditionally driven by IsVisible={Binding ShowCoverPanel}. The code-behind has a parameterless constructor with a fire-and-forget Loaded handler calling vm.LoadAsync(), and an OnMoviesGridSelectionChanged handler that syncs vm.SelectedMovies. dotnet build -c Release produces 0 warnings and 0 errors; all 352 existing tests pass."]

comments.note: MoviesListView.axaml uses {ReflectionBinding ElementName=LayoutRoot, Path=DataContext.SetColumnVisibilityCommand} in each column's header ContextMenu because DataGrid column header DataTemplates sit outside the compiled binding scope. This is the idiomatic Avalonia 11 workaround for ContextMenu command bindings that must reach a parent VM. The approach is safe and produces no build warnings, but if Avalonia adds compiled-binding support for ContextMenu source resolution in a future version, these could be migrated to compiled bindings for a small runtime performance gain.

The CheckBox uses IsChecked={Binding ShowCoverPanel, Mode=OneWay} combined with Command={Binding ToggleCoverPanelCommand}. This is the correct pattern to avoid double-toggling (TwoWay + Command would flip the value twice). If the ViewModel later exposes a partial void OnShowCoverPanelChanged handler that persists settings, the Command could be dropped in favour of a simpler TwoWay binding.

Column widths in MoviesListView.axaml are hardcoded pixel values (e.g., Width=70 for Rating). In a future milestone these should be persisted in MoviesListOptions.ColumnWidths (new dictionary property) and restored via binding, consistent with how ColumnVisibility is handled.

In the expected runtime scenario this is always safe (ItemsSource is ObservableCollection<MovieListItem>), but if the collection type ever changes, a ClassCastException would be thrown. summary: [FAIL] One blocking issue: the DataGrid element in MoviesListView.axaml is missing IsReadOnly=\"True\". In Avalonia, DataGridTextColumn cells are editable by default (activated via double-click or F2). The developer set IsReadOnly=\"True\" on the three DataGridCheckBoxColumn entries to prevent single-click toggling, but omitted it from the DataGrid root — leaving all nine text columns double-click-editable. MoviesListViewModel exposes no edit/save path, so this is a pure browse view; text cell editability is an unintended affordance. Fix: add IsReadOnly=\"True\" to the <DataGrid> element (propagates to all columns, making the three existing column-level IsReadOnly attributes redundant but harmless).
